evidenceSource: static read-only inspection of productive code + the stored BASE-ENGINE-A-WIDTHS-V1 artefacts

techniqueKinds.proposed: a technique computed from geometry that is not necessarily written back (EIE adaptStitchType, stitchPlanner classifyStitchType)
techniqueKinds.effective: region.stitch_type as it stands after region_builder — the value every later consumer reads
techniqueKinds.parameterDriving: the technique used to pick density / compensation / underlay / stitch length
techniqueKinds.commandDriving: the technique used to choose the geometry generator inside buildFinalCommands
techniqueKinds.displayOnly: the technique used exclusively for badges, labels and preview thickness

stages.inputField: raw region from hybridDigitize / fusion / contours
stages.inputValue: stitch_type may be absent or supplied by the backend

stages.techniqueKind: n/a — width is available in mm from here, but no technique logic reads it

stages.computedValue: sem.stitch_type when a semantic object matched

stages.valueOverwritten: the EIE proposal itself is discarded
stages.outputField: adapted.stitch_type (regionBuilder.js:448) plus density / compensation / underlay / angle derived FROM the kept technique

stages.computedValue: 'fill' for every non-contour region without region_class
stages.valueKept: stitch_type of border contours, whitelisted dark details, and regions with a non-fill region_class
stages.techniqueKind: effective — this is the last write before every consumer

stages.downstreamConsumer: StitchPlannerPanel (UI), plan warnings (SATIN_TOO_WIDE), time estimate, needle path metrics
stages.evidence: src/lib/exportPipeline.js does not import stitchPlanner; buildFinalCommands receives regions, never ctx.stitchPlan. The plan only reaches regions if the user presses Apply in StitchPlannerPanel (Editor.jsx onApplyPlan).

stages.downstreamConsumer: simulator, Final Look, DST/DSB encoders, CE01 validation

branchDetail.nonContourRoute: processObjectStitches (src/lib/industrialStitchProcessor.js:326-408): stitch_type 'fill' → generateClippedFillStitches; anything else (satin, running) → the plain normalized polygon path, line 400-402 'Satin / running: constant density path along polygon'

stages.computedValue: thread thickness factor (satin 1.15 vs fill 0.78) and technical-mode styling

stages.techniqueKind: none — no encoder reads stitch_type (no 'satin' occurrence in dstEncoder.js)
